training_source: ChEMBL CHEMBL206 exact Ki, literature source, binding assays with confidence 9 and no annotated variant
label: pKi = 9 - log10(Ki in nM)
external_aggregation: unweighted mean of five validation-fold models
architecture: existing full SGF-DTA affinity network; frozen Uni-Mol2 and ESM-2 features; freshly trained affinity head and interaction branch
feature_exclusion: One training structure failed both standard ETKDG and random-coordinate embedding in the existing encoder pipeline before any affinity-model fitting; all 63 external compounds have complete features.
selection_basis: target chosen for a public direct competitive-binding confirmation screen containing active and inactive compounds, before fitting models or viewing prediction performance
scope: retrospective non-kinase screening case; validation folds select parameters and are not an unbiased internal benchmark
